shortDescription: Manages configuration of an OSPF instance on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: addr
options.description: Specifies the address of the network segment where the interface resides. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: area
options.description: Specifies the area ID. The area with the area-id being 0 is a backbone area. Valid values are a string, formatted as an IP address (i.e. "0.0.0.0") or as an integer between 1 and 4294967295.

options.name: auth_key_id
options.description: Authentication key id when C(auth_mode) is 'hmac-sha256', 'md5' or 'hmac-md5. Valid value is an integer is in the range from 1 to 255.

options.name: auth_text_md5
options.description: Specifies a password for MD5, HMAC-MD5, or HMAC-SHA256 authentication. The value is a string of 1 to 255 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.

options.name: auth_text_simple
options.description: Specifies a password for simple authentication. The value is a string of 1 to 8 characters.

options.name: mask
options.description: IP network wildcard bits in decimal format between 0 and 32.

options.name: max_load_balance
options.description: The maximum number of paths for forward packets over multiple paths. Valid value is an integer in the range from 1 to 64.

options.name: nexthop_addr
options.description: IPv4 address for configure next-hop address's weight. Valid values are a string, formatted as an IP address.

options.name: nexthop_weight
options.description: Indicates the weight of the next hop. The smaller the value is, the higher the preference of the route is. It is an integer that ranges from 1 to 254.

options.name: process_id
options.description: Specifies a process ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.
